content.title: Transforming Communities
content.tagline: Building a future where every woman lives with dignity and every child has the opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive.

content.heading: How It All Began
paragraphs: MANN Care Foundation believes that true social progress begins with the well-being of women and children. A healthy woman nurtures a strong family, and an educated child shapes a brighter future.
Guided by this belief, the Foundation was established to address essential yet often overlooked needs such as nutrition, education, menstrual hygiene, healthcare awareness, and women empowerment.
Through compassionate action and community-driven solutions, MANN Care Foundation works to create meaningful and lasting change in the lives of underserved individuals and families.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To build an inclusive society where every woman and child has access to opportunities, resources, health, education, and dignity.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To empower women and children through sustainable programs focused on nutrition, education, health, hygiene, and self-reliance.

items.title: Nutrition
items.description: Ensuring no woman or child is deprived of nutritious food.

items.title: Education
items.description: Creating equal learning opportunities for every child.

items.title: Health & Hygiene
items.description: Promoting preventive healthcare and healthy living practices.

items.title: Women Empowerment
items.description: Building confidence, skills, independence, and leadership.
